units: <cite ref="Shabbat 145a:15">Sabb. 145ᵃ</cite> <he>דְּרִיסַת זיתים וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="D01086"><he>דְּרִיכַת</he></cite>) treading olives &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:6">Meg. I, 6</cite> <he>דריסת הרגל</he> entering one’s ground, the benefit of crossing; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:8:2">Y. Erub. VI, 23ᵈ</cite> bot.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:1:6">Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ</cite> top <he>מקום ד׳</he> a place for crossing, (right of way but not ownership of the interior of the soil).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:1">Lev. R. s. 3</cite>, beg. <he>ד׳ אחת וכ׳</he> one passing which the Lord passed.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:1:25">Y. Sabb. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כל המעכב דרסה</he> (corr. acc.) whatever prevents from crossing; a. fr.—
